title: Making Sense of Demonyms - Nationality Nouns (1/2)
titleZh: 搞懂國民稱謂──表示國籍的名詞（1/2）
summaryZh: 介紹英文如何用字尾構成稱呼某國人民的名詞。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Everyday Grammar

sentences.text: Last week in Everyday Grammar, we looked at how English forms adjectives for country names.
sentences.zh: 上週的《日常文法》單元，我們談了英文怎麼把國家名變成形容詞。

sentences.text: We found that, as is often true, history can explain some of the irregularities in the English language.
sentences.zh: 我們發現，就像常見的情況一樣，英文裡有些不規則的地方可以從歷史找到答案。

sentences.text: The endings we add to the country name, called suffixes, were borrowed many years ago from Greek, Latin, French, and even Arabic.
sentences.zh: 我們加在國名後面的字尾，很多年前是從希臘文、拉丁文、法文，甚至阿拉伯文借過來的。

sentences.text: This week, we will look at how English forms nouns that refer to the people of a country.
sentences.zh: 這週我們要看的是，英文怎麼構成指稱某個國家人民的名詞。

sentences.text: The name for this kind of noun is demonym.
sentences.zh: 這類名詞叫做 demonym，也就是國民稱謂。

sentences.text: You can probably guess it is from the same Greek word form dem, meaning the people, as in the English word democracy.
sentences.zh: 你大概猜得到，它來自希臘文字根 dem，意思是「人民」，就像英文的 democracy（民主）一樣。

sentences.text: Often the adjective and the demonym are the same, as in American, for something from the United States.
sentences.zh: 形容詞和國民稱謂常常是同一個字，例如 American 可以指來自美國的東西。

sentences.text: And Americans, for people from the U.S.
But in some cases, the adjective and the demonym are different.
sentences.zh: 不過在某些情況下，形容詞和國民稱謂並不一樣。

sentences.text: The adjective for Iceland is Icelandic.
But the demonym, what we call a person from Iceland, is Icelander.
sentences.zh: 但是國民稱謂，也就是我們怎麼稱呼冰島人，是 Icelander。

sentences.text: Let us begin with the suffix ish, which is from Old English isk, a Germanic form.
sentences.zh: 我們先從字尾 -ish 說起，它來自古英文的 -isk，是一種日耳曼語的形式。

sentences.text: Early English speakers added ish to make Swedish, Spanish, Scottish, and Irish.
sentences.zh: 早期講英文的人加上 -ish，造出 Swedish、Spanish、Scottish 和 Irish。

sentences.text: This was shortened to ch for some close neighbors, Dutch, Scotch, and French.
sentences.zh: 對某些鄰近的民族，這個字尾縮短成 -ch，例如 Dutch、Scotch 和 French。

sentences.text: The English speakers called themselves British or Britons.
sentences.zh: 講英文的人則自稱 British 或 Britons。
